name: evalexpr_rhai_max_array_size
description: Maximum number of elements of any array created by an evalexpr_rhai() script (0 = unlimited)

name: evalexpr_rhai_max_call_levels
description: Maximum depth of nested function calls in an evalexpr_rhai() script (0 = unlimited)

name: evalexpr_rhai_max_map_size
description: Maximum number of properties of any object map created by an evalexpr_rhai() script (0 = unlimited)

name: evalexpr_rhai_max_operations
description: Maximum number of Rhai operations a single evalexpr_rhai() evaluation may perform (0 = unlimited)

name: evalexpr_rhai_max_string_size
description: Maximum length in bytes of any string created by an evalexpr_rhai() script (0 = unlimited)
